tools.name: describe_rates
tools.description: Describe the latest published crawl: crawl date, row count, and the real line, source, ship, and rate values. Call this before search_rates when an exact line, source, or ship name is unknown. Prices are not converted between currencies.

tools.name: search_rates
tools.description: Search the latest published cruise fares. This is the full crawl, including Contitrans and Crusit. Empty line, source, ship, or rate means all of that dimension. Values within one of those filters are OR; filters combine with AND. title, line, source, ship, rate, and sort ignore case. title is a sub
